resources.string: To show your app time and reel estimates, ReelCounter needs Android\'s Usage access permission. Here\'s exactly what that means:
ReelCounter reads when the apps you choose (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook) were open on screen, and for how long, including the past day your phone has already recorded.
It never reads what you watch, read or type, and it never records your screen.

If you also turn on reel counting, ReelCounter\'s accessibility service adds one to a count each time a new video fills the screen in those apps\' short-video feeds. It looks only at the feed\'s layout (which video is on screen), never at captions, names, comments or messages, and stores only the number.
Usage of every other app is ignored and never stored.

Each day\'s totals per app (app time and reel estimates) are saved to your ReelCounter account, so they\'re backed up and available on your other devices. The detailed session times stay on this device.
Friends you accept can see your daily totals. You\'ll be able to choose exactly who sees what in Privacy settings.
Without reel counting, reel counts are estimates worked out from app time, and they\'re always labeled as estimates.
You can pause tracking in Settings or turn off Usage access at any time.
Turn on ReelCounter reel counting to count each Short, Reel and TikTok you watch, one by one, instead of estimating from app time.
Open Installed apps (or Downloaded apps) and choose ReelCounter reel counting.
Turn it on and tap Allow, then come back.
On Android 13 and later, apps installed from a file need one extra step: open App info, tap ⋮ in the top corner, choose Allow restricted settings, then try again.
It looks only at which video is on screen in TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. It never reads captions, names or messages and never records your screen. You can turn it off any time.
Reels are counted one by one as each new video fills the screen.
Reels are estimated from app time. Turn on counting for exact numbers.
You can change this any time in Settings.
